data.body:
[P2] Validate the exact envelope that will be returned

`fitsCheckpoint` serializes `fileEnvelope`, but after publishing the payload this code serializes it again. A custom preview may return mutable data or values with nondeterministic Jackson serialization, so the second encoding can exceed the configured limit or fail after the preflight passed, leaving an unreferenced file and potentially submitting an oversized checkpoint. Encode the file envelope once before publication, measure that exact encoding, then write the payload and return the already-validated string. Add a regression preview whose serialized size changes between calls.
